title: The Moonstone Markdown
story: In the fog-lit Fogmarket, Pennilore the Fogmarket Factor has locked a village's harvest seed in a glass case and will only release it for moonstone shards. Mr 6 has a pouch of 240 shards and a very sharp pencil. Pennilore chants her price: 'The seed costs 180 shards, plus a fog tax of 25% of that price, minus a loyalty rebate of 10% of the original price.'
question: How many moonstone shards will Mr 6 have left in his pouch after paying Pennilore?
solution: Fog tax is 25% of 180 = 45, and the rebate is 10% of 180 = 18.
praise: Taking the percents of 180 was the right move — the last step was subtracting that total from the 240 shards in the pouch.
hint: Work out the tax and the rebate separately from the 180-shard price, then build the final bill before touching the 240.
victory: Pennilore recounted three times, found Mr 6 right every time, and slid the seed across with a fog-damp sigh. The village planted it by morning, and Mr 6 kept 33 shards for honey cakes.
imagePrompt: A lantern-lit foggy night market stall where a tall cloaked wisp-merchant with coin-bright eyes guards a glass case of glowing seed, facing a small numeral-six knight tallying moonstones on a slate.
